pokedex.542: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
pokedex.543: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.
pokedex.544: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
pokedex.545: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.
pokedex.546: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
pokedex.547: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.
pokedex.548: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
pokedex.549: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.
pokedex.550: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
pokedex.551: It moves along below the sand’s surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.
pokedex.552: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
pokedex.553: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
pokedex.554: Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
pokedex.555: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
pokedex.556: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
pokedex.557: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
pokedex.558: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
pokedex.559: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
pokedex.560: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
pokedex.561: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
pokedex.562: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
pokedex.563: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
pokedex.564: About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
pokedex.565: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
pokedex.566: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.
pokedex.567: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
pokedex.568: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
pokedex.569: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
pokedex.570: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
pokedex.571: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.
pokedex.572: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
pokedex.573: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
pokedex.574: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
pokedex.575: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.
pokedex.576: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
pokedex.577: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.
pokedex.578: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
pokedex.579: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.
pokedex.580: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
pokedex.581: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.
pokedex.582: The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
pokedex.583: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.
pokedex.584: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.
pokedex.585: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.
pokedex.586: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
pokedex.587: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.
pokedex.588: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
pokedex.589: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
pokedex.590: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
pokedex.591: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.
pokedex.592: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.
pokedex.593: Its body is mostly seawater. It’s said there’s a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.
pokedex.594: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.
pokedex.595: Since it can’t generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.
pokedex.596: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.
pokedex.597: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
pokedex.598: By swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes, it can obliterate an opponent.
pokedex.599: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.
pokedex.600: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
pokedex.601: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.
pokedex.602: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
pokedex.603: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
pokedex.604: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
pokedex.605: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
pokedex.606: Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven’t been decoded.
pokedex.607: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.
pokedex.608: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.
pokedex.609: Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
pokedex.610: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
pokedex.611: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.
pokedex.612: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
pokedex.613: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.
pokedex.614: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.
pokedex.615: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.
pokedex.616: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.
pokedex.617: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
pokedex.618: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
pokedex.619: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.
pokedex.620: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
pokedex.621: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.
pokedex.622: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
pokedex.623: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
pokedex.624: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
pokedex.625: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.
pokedex.626: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.
pokedex.627: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
pokedex.628: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.
pokedex.629: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
pokedex.630: They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.
pokedex.631: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant’s steel bodies and consume their insides.
pokedex.632: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.
pokedex.633: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
pokedex.634: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
pokedex.635: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
pokedex.636: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.
pokedex.637: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
pokedex.638: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
pokedex.639: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.
pokedex.640: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.
pokedex.641: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
pokedex.642: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.
pokedex.643: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.
pokedex.644: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.
pokedex.645: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
pokedex.646: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
pokedex.647: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
pokedex.648: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.
pokedex.649: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
pokedex.650: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
pokedex.651: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
pokedex.652: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
pokedex.653: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedex.654: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
pokedex.655: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
pokedex.656: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
pokedex.657: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
pokedex.658: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
pokedex.659: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
pokedex.660: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
pokedex.661: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
pokedex.662: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
pokedex.663: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
pokedex.664: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
pokedex.665: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
pokedex.666: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
pokedex.667: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
pokedex.668: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
pokedex.669: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
pokedex.670: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
pokedex.671: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
pokedex.672: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
pokedex.673: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
pokedex.674: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
pokedex.675: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
pokedex.676: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
pokedex.677: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
pokedex.678: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
pokedex.679: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
pokedex.680: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
pokedex.681: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
pokedex.682: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
pokedex.683: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
pokedex.684: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
pokedex.685: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
pokedex.686: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
pokedex.687: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
pokedex.688: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
pokedex.689: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
pokedex.690: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
pokedex.691: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
pokedex.692: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
pokedex.693: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
pokedex.694: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
pokedex.695: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
pokedex.696: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
pokedex.697: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
pokedex.698: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
pokedex.699: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
pokedex.700: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
pokedex.701: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
pokedex.702: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
pokedex.703: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
pokedex.704: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.
pokedex.705: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.
pokedex.706: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
pokedex.707: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
pokedex.708: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
pokedex.709: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
pokedex.710: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
pokedex.711: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
pokedex.712: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
pokedex.713: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
pokedex.714: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
pokedex.715: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
pokedex.716: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
pokedex.717: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
pokedex.718: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
pokedex.719: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
pokedex.720: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
pokedex.721: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

moves.pound: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.
moves.scratch: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.
moves.teleport: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. It can also warp to the last Pokémon Center visited.
moves.night-shade: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.
moves.mimic: The user copies the target’s last move. The move can be used during battle until the Pokémon is switched out.
moves.screech: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target’s Defense stat.
moves.double-team: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
moves.recover: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.
moves.harden: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.
moves.minimize: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.
moves.smokescreen: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target’s accuracy.
moves.confuse-ray: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.
moves.vice-grip: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.
moves.withdraw: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.
moves.defense-curl: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.
moves.barrier: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.
moves.light-screen: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special attacks for five turns.
moves.haze: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.
moves.reflect: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.
moves.focus-energy: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.
moves.bide: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.
moves.metronome: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
moves.mirror-move: The user counters the target by mimicking the target’s last move.
moves.guillotine: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
moves.self-destruct: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
moves.egg-bomb: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.
moves.lick: The target is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.smog: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. This may also poison the target.
moves.sludge: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.
moves.bone-club: The user clubs the target with a bone. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.fire-blast: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.waterfall: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. This can also be used to climb a waterfall.
moves.clamp: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.
moves.swift: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.
moves.razor-wind: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit opposing Pokémon on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.skull-bash: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense in the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.
moves.spike-cannon: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.
moves.constrict: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles or vines. This may also lower the target’s Speed stat.
moves.amnesia: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.kinesis: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target’s accuracy.
moves.soft-boiled: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.
moves.high-jump-kick: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.
moves.glare: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.
moves.dream-eater: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal its own HP.
moves.poison-gas: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon. This may also poison those hit.
moves.swords-dance: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.
moves.barrage: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.
moves.leech-life: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
moves.lovely-kiss: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.
moves.sky-attack: A second-turn attack move where critical hits land more easily. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.transform: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.
moves.bubble: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their Speed stats.
moves.dizzy-punch: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches. This may also leave the target confused.
moves.spore: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.
moves.flash: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target’s accuracy.
moves.psywave: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.
moves.cut: The target is cut with a scythe or claw. This can also be used to cut down thin trees.
moves.splash: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...
moves.acid-armor: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.
moves.crabhammer: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.explosion: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
moves.fury-swipes: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes quickly two to five times in a row.
moves.bonemerang: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops to hit the target twice, coming and going.
moves.rest: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.
moves.rock-slide: Large boulders are hurled at the opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.
moves.hyper-fang: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.sharpen: The user lowers its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.
moves.gust: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.
moves.conversion: The user changes its type to become the same type as the move at the top of the list of moves it knows.
moves.tri-attack: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also burn, freeze, or leave the target with paralysis.
moves.super-fang: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target’s HP in half.
moves.slash: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.substitute: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.
moves.sketch: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears.
moves.triple-kick: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.
moves.thief: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. The user can’t steal anything if it already holds an item.
moves.spider-web: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can’t flee from battle.
moves.wing-attack: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.
moves.mind-reader: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.
moves.nightmare: A sleeping target sees a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.
moves.flame-wheel: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.snore: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.
moves.curse: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.
